recommended_pitch_wording: GeoQoE Pulse combines a real-data spatial QoE baseline with a transparently simulated next-hour onset-ranking workflow. The system highlights observed, AI-estimated and simulated outputs separately and exposes model-support indicators.
limitations: Hourly QoE and onset labels are simulated. Forecast metrics do not validate performance on observed hourly telecom telemetry.
The static model has low spatial out-of-fold R-squared and should be treated as a rough estimator.
Ookla-labelled and unlabelled cells have strongly different GIS coverage patterns.
Model disagreement and reliability categories are relative support indicators, not calibrated confidence probabilities.
Test results were evaluated once and were not used to change the selected model or threshold.

static_model.purpose: Estimate a static spatial QoE baseline for cells without direct Ookla labels
static_model.usage: Use as a rough spatial baseline and blind-spot estimate, not as a direct measurement or precise guaranteed Mbps value.

onset_model.purpose: Rank currently normal anchored cells by next-hour degradation-onset risk
onset_model.selection_basis: Highest validation PR-AUC before final-test evaluation
onset_model.important_observation: Current and lagged QoE features dominate the model. GIS and demand context produced a modest validation improvement, but the QoE-history-only model achieved a higher PR-AUC on the final test period.
onset_model.score_interpretation: Relative onset-risk score, not a calibrated probability
